provenance.method: exact: the state is not a stabilizer state (its phase on the even-weight strings is not a Z_4 quadratic form)

notes: chi(cat_3) >= 2: |cat_3> = (|000> + i(|011> + |101> + |110>))/2 is not a stabilizer state. Qassim, Pashayan, and Gosset (arXiv:2106.07740, appendix) show it through the Pauli spectrum, <cat_3|XXI|cat_3> = 1/2; the certificate decides the same fact in integer arithmetic on the exact amplitudes: the support is the affine subspace of even-weight strings, but the phase i^{|x|/2} on it is not a Z_4 quadratic form with even cross terms (at x = 011, x' = 101 the ratio f(x + x') f(0)/(f(x) f(x')) is -i). With bounds/cat-m3-upper-2.json the cell is exact, chi(cat_3) = 2, as in their Table 1.
